name: caption
description: Group transcript words into caption lines (a caption track for the render engine)

input.description: Word-level JSON transcript from the transcribe step

output.description: Caption track JSON with timed word segments, ready for the render engine

params.name: max-words
params.description: Most words a caption holds (1-12). Default by style: 4, or 8 for word-by-word and pop. A caption also ends at a sentence's end and at a clause's comma.
